name: Coco Mademoiselle
description: Coco Mademoiselle is a fresh, oriental fragrance for women created by Jacques Polge for Chanel in 2001. Named after Coco Chanel herself, it captures a spirit of irreverence and modernity. This scent has become one of the best-selling women's fragrances of all time, beloved for its balanced, elegant, yet youthful character.
